verdict.rationale: React is a UI component library, not an agent or AI host application. Plugging in MCP servers so the product itself can call their tools is an MCP-client role that a rendering library does not take, so this is a category error. Nothing in the evidence pack shows React shipping any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
